evidence.detail: face_properties() lists power, toughness, loyalty but not defense — no defense column in the face table
Scryfall card loading captures power/toughness/loyalty but has no result['defense'] assignment
search handles power, toughness, loyalty criteria but has no defense handler — searching by defense is not supported
zero hits — defense is absent from the entire card model, data loading, and search layers

triage.notes: Adding defense requires: (1) new column in the face table (ALTER TABLE migration), (2) adding defense to face_properties() in magic/card.py, (3) loading it from Scryfall in multiverse.py, (4) adding a search criterion in find/search.py similar to loyalty. The schema change makes this migration-required.
